Respiratory Health.smoke: Smoking increases the risk of lung disease, chronic bronchitis, and lung cancer.
Respiratory Health.passive_smoke: Exposure to passive smoking may increase respiratory and cardiovascular risks.

Cardiovascular Health.alcohol: Frequent alcohol consumption can increase the risk of high blood pressure and heart disease.

Overall Well-being.nipple_discharge: Nipple discharge may require medical evaluation for potential underlying issues.
Overall Well-being.post_menopause_bleeding: Post-menopausal bleeding should be checked by a doctor as it could indicate health issues.
